info.name: Apache Log4j2 Remote Code Execution (Log4Shell)
author: pdteam
info.description: Apache Log4j2 <=2.14.1 JNDI features do not protect against attacker-controlled LDAP endpoints, allowing remote code execution.

info.name: Atlassian Confluence OGNL Injection RCE
author: pdteam
info.description: Unauthenticated OGNL injection in Atlassian Confluence Server/Data Center allows remote code execution.
info.remediation: Apply the Atlassian security advisory patch for CVE-2022-26134.

info.name: Spring Boot Actuator Exposed /env Endpoint
author: pdteam
info.description: The Spring Boot Actuator /env endpoint is publicly exposed and may leak secrets and environment configuration.
info.remediation: Restrict actuator endpoints and require authentication.

info.name: Apache Tomcat Manager Default Credentials (admin:admin)
author: pdteam
info.description: The Tomcat Manager application is accessible with default credentials.
info.remediation: Change or disable the default Tomcat Manager credentials.

info.name: Jenkins Login Panel Exposed
author: pdteam
info.description: A Jenkins login panel is exposed to the internet.

info.name: Git Configuration File Exposure
author: pdteam
info.description: A publicly accessible .git/config file was found, which can leak repository and credential information.

info.name: Deprecated TLS 1.0 Supported
author: pdteam
info.description: The server negotiates the deprecated TLS 1.0 protocol, a PCI-DSS compliance violation.

info.name: Nginx Version Detection
author: pdteam
info.description: Detected the Nginx web server and its version banner.
